snippet.title: Factory Story - Launch Trailer | Open-Ended Puzzle Automation Game
snippet.description:
Kaizen: A Factory Story is an open-ended puzzle automation game from the original Zachtronics team, set in 1980s Japan. Design, build, and optimize production lines to create iconic products, like calculators, camcorders, and arcade machines. 

Buy Kaizen now:
⟁ https://store.steampowered.com/app/22...

Media kit for more info:
⟁ https://astralogical.org/game-kaizen
